## Summary
Build the create_exam_session Postgres RPC that atomically creates an exam session and its session_items in a single transaction, plus the service wrapper and API route to start an exam.

## User story
As a student, I want to start an exam and have my session created atomically, so that I never end up with a half-initialized exam state that could lose my answers.

## Why this matters
If session creation is not atomic (AP-17), a crash between inserting the session and inserting session_items leaves an orphaned session with no items. The student sees a blank exam. The auto-save system (C01) depends on session_items existing from the start. This is a CRITICAL production finding.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] create_exam_session RPC creates exam_sessions row + all session_items in one transaction
- [ ] RPC returns the session ID and item count on success
- [ ] RPC rolls back entirely if any insert fails (no orphaned sessions)
- [ ] API route POST /api/exams/[id]/session calls the RPC and returns session data
- [ ] Only approved (active) students can create a session (status check in RPC or service)
- [ ] Student cannot create a second active session for the same exam (unique constraint)
- [ ] Inngest event journey/exam.started is emitted after successful session creation
- [ ] Session has started_at timestamp and calculated expires_at (exam.duration_minutes)

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| AP-17 | Sequential insert BANNED — must use supabase.rpc('create_exam_session') |
| C01 | Auto-save depends on session_items existing — atomic creation is prerequisite |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Supabase-first — session lives in Supabase, no Neo4j write needed |
| Data Layer | createServerClient() in API route, Row<'exam_sessions'> for types |
| Data Layer | supabase.rpc() for the atomic multi-table operation |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- Postgres RPC function
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_exam_session(
  p_exam_id UUID,
  p_student_id UUID,
  p_institution_id UUID,
  p_duration_minutes INTEGER,
  p_item_ids UUID[]
)
RETURNS JSON
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_session_id UUID;
  v_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ := now();
  v_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
BEGIN
  v_expires_at := v_started_at + (p_duration_minutes || ' minutes')::INTERVAL;

  -- Check no active session exists for this student+exam
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.exam_sessions
    WHERE exam_id = p_exam_id
      AND student_id = p_student_id
      AND completed_at IS NULL
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active session already exists for this exam';
  END IF;

  -- Create session
  INSERT INTO public.exam_sessions (exam_id, student_id, institution_id, started_at, expires_at)
  VALUES (p_exam_id, p_student_id, p_institution_id, v_started_at, v_expires_at)
  RETURNING id INTO v_session_id;

  -- Create session items
  INSERT INTO public.session_items (session_id, assessment_item_id, position)
  SELECT v_session_id, unnest(p_item_ids), generate_series(1, array_length(p_item_ids, 1));

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'session_id', v_session_id,
    'started_at', v_started_at,
    'expires_at', v_expires_at,
    'item_count', array_length(p_item_ids, 1)
  );
END;
$$;
```

Events consumed: None
onFailure: N/A — failure rolls back the RPC transaction

## API contract
```
POST /app/api/exams/[id]/session
Headers: Cookie (student session)
Request: {} (exam ID from URL, student from session)
Response 200: { data: { session_id, started_at, expires_at, item_count }, error: null }
Response 400: { data: null, error: { code: 'SESSION_EXISTS', message: 'Active session already exists' } }
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Not authenticated' } }
Response 403: { data: null, error: { code: 'NOT_APPROVED', message: 'Student not approved' } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/exam-delivery/services/ExamSessionService.ts
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import type { Row } from '@journey/db/client';
import { inngest } from '@journey/inngest/client';

export class ExamSessionService {
  async createSession(examId: string, studentId: string, institutionId: string) {
    const supabase = createServerClient();

    // Fetch exam to get duration + item pool
    const { data: exam } = await supabase
      .from('exams')
      .select('duration_minutes, exam_items(assessment_item_id)')
      .eq('id', examId)
      .single();

    if (!exam) throw new Error('Exam not found');

    const itemIds = exam.exam_items.map((ei: { assessment_item_id: string }) => ei.assessment_item_id);

    // Atomic RPC — AP-17 compliant
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('create_exam_session', {
      p_exam_id: examId,
      p_student_id: studentId,
      p_institution_id: institutionId,
      p_duration_minutes: exam.duration_minutes,
      p_item_ids: itemIds,
    });

    if (error) throw error;

    // Emit Inngest event after successful creation
    await inngest.send({
      name: 'journey/exam.started',
      data: { session_id: data.session_id, exam_id: examId, student_id: studentId },
    });

    return data;
  }
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-17: Sequential inserts for atomic operations — BANNED
const { data: session } = await supabase.from('exam_sessions').insert({...}).select().single();
// If crash happens HERE, orphaned session with no items!
await supabase.from('session_items').insert(items); // BANNED

// ✓ Use: supabase.rpc('create_exam_session', {...}) — single atomic transaction

// ✗ AP-16: Hand-written interfaces
interface ExamSession { id: string; started_at: string; } // BANNED
// ✓ Use: Row<'exam_sessions'>
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E07/E07-S02.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('POST /api/exams/[id]/session creates session atomically', async ({ request }) => {
  // Requires authenticated student with approved status
  const res = await request.post('/api/exams/test-exam-id/session');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.session_id).toBeTruthy();
  expect(data.item_count).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(data.expires_at).toBeTruthy();
});

test('POST /api/exams/[id]/session returns 400 if session already exists', async ({ request }) => {
  // Create first session
  await request.post('/api/exams/test-exam-id/session');
  // Attempt second
  const res = await request.post('/api/exams/test-exam-id/session');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(400);
  const { error } = await res.json();
  expect(error.code).toBe('SESSION_EXISTS');
});

test('Negative: unauthenticated request returns 401', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post('/api/exams/test-exam-id/session');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.create_exam_session;`
2. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.session_items CASCADE;`
3. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.exam_sessions CASCADE;`
4. No Neo4j changes to revert.
5. `git stash && git checkout develop`
